text.p: A powerful explosion rocked Algiers on Tuesday but the cause and exact location were not immediately known, residents said.
"We heard a blast at about 4:45 p.m (1545 GMT) in the capital but we do not know where exactly," said one resident.
Algiers's residents, reached by telephone, said they saw smoke billowing over heights in the city near from where they heard the blast.

The explosion came two days after a huge car bomb explosion in Algiers in which 42 people were killed and more than 100 wounded, according to Algerian newspapers. The authorities had put the death toll at 21.
About 60,000 people had been killed in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
